crossRefs.note: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land…
The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of…
They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath…
They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude…
all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out…
Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you…
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
“I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who…
Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

translations.web: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”
translations.bsb: because the hill country will be yours as well. It is a forest; clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours. Although the Canaanites have iron chariots and although they are strong, you can drive them out.”
translations.kjv: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
translations.asv: but the hill-country shall be thine; for though it is a forest, thou shalt cut it down, and the goings out thereof shall be thine; for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.
